newsitem.title: UK: Russia may release some stock piled minor metals.
newsitem.headline: Russia may release some stock piled minor metals.

text.p: Trade sources said that Russia may be prepared to release some material from strategic metal stockpiles.
Metal traders said they believed that 420 tonnes of cobalt, 30,000 76 lbs flasks of mercury, 7,000 tonnes of titanium sponge and an undisclosed amount of chrome could be released.
However, trade sources said that official authorisation for the release of the stockpiled metal had still to be sought and they were unsure if this would be given.
